description.title: Check the batch production rate on a given testnet
description.purpose:
Logs out the transaction and batch count every X interval seconds, and after an elapsed duration checks that the increase is not greater than a threshold value. The test is part of the health test suite to run the e2e tests against the network.
Note that tests in the check category do not store any information into the e2e test database - they either just extract data from the database to perform the check, or get snapshots from the network.
